description:
JStock is open on the Portfolio Management tab showing existing buy transactions for AAPL, MSFT, and NVDA. Your task is to edit the existing Microsoft (MSFT) transaction to record the transaction costs and add a note. Locate the MSFT transaction (50 units purchased Jan 15, 2024), edit it, and update the following fields:

1. Broker Fee: 9.99
2. Clearing Fee: 0.03
3. Comment: 'Q1 2024 core holding'

Leave all other fields and transactions unchanged. Confirm the changes so they are saved to the portfolio.
